title_zh: 发现台灯电线露出后约定送检

scenario.label_zh: 看到灯线问题后停止调整并约定送检
scenario.goal_zh: 说明抬灯罩时发现电线可见，确认灯已拔电并决定不再调整而交维修店检查

context_zh: 合住者讨论一盏已拔电的旧台灯，不进行电气维修。
author: author-phase09-c

sentences.speaker: Yara
sentences.text: I tilted the shade upwards, and now a wire is visible behind the fitting.

sentences.speaker: Cole
sentences.text: Is the lamp still plugged in?

sentences.speaker: Yara
sentences.text: No. I unplugged it before moving it. I haven't touched the wire.

sentences.speaker: Cole
sentences.text: Let's leave it as it is rather than try to push anything back.

sentences.speaker: Yara
sentences.text: Agreed. I'll take it to the repair shop and ask them to inspect it.

sentences.speaker: Cole
sentences.text: I'll use the other lamp tonight. We don't need to test this one ourselves.
